question: Z3: a Layers row held by the real mouse, 1px at a time. Unnamed presses on the rows. Up, down, in x, and the blocks z while held.
steps: Line up 110, kept held and taken home
Shape down 110, kept held and taken home
answer: A Layers row held by the real mouse. A drag starts at 9 px in x or y: the blue slot shows, the ghost doesn't move yet. From 10 px it follows y one for one. It never follows x: at 80 px across it stays in its column. A row passes the next at 24 px, the one after at 71 px, up and down alike. So 24 + 47. A drop at 24 moves one row. The blocks' z don't change while held, only on the drop. Row text stays at opacity 1. The ghost is not stopped at the list's ends, at least by 110 px.
ours: Same for x and z. Ours starts at 4 px, only in y, and passes at 25 and 72. A drop at 24 moves nothing in ours.
differs: a drag starts: oracle at 9 px in x or y, ours at 4 px in y only
a row passes: oracle at 24 and 71, ours at 25 and 72
pressed: Real press and move on the rows, unnamed, in the Layers panel of an unsaved section.
